title: Hierholzer's Algorithm: Eulerian Path Construction and Circuit Decomposition
description: Formalizes key components of Hierholzer's algorithm for Eulerian paths. Proves: Euler's theorem existence direction (connected + all even degrees → Eulerian circuit), Eulerian walk edge count, generalized impossibility (≥4 odd vertices → no Eulerian path), K₃ concrete example, and the key Hierholzer invariant (circuit removal preserves even degrees). 2 axioms for the main Eulerian circuit existence. 15 theorems.
